claim_boundary: Counts describe target observations in one verified source snapshot. Reported coordinates are kept separate from canonical EPSG:4326 coordinates; only canonical cells enter cross-source spatial coverage. Cells are observed, not interpolated; comparable means the minimum declared V4 grouping fields are present.
coordinate_count_definition: reported_coordinate_sample_count is numeric and range-valid in source coordinates; valid_coordinate_sample_count additionally requires canonical EPSG:4326

region_applicability.evidence_basis: The publisher-registered immutable member inventory explicitly includes KOHISTAN-LADAKH_TERRANE_OR_GANGDISE_BELT (the Gangdese belt of southern Tibet) for China and KAMCHATKA_ARC, KURILE_ARC, OKHOTSK-CHUKOTKA_ARC, SIKHOTE-ALIN-SAKHALIN_ARC and UDA-MURGAL_ARC for Russia. This proves routing relevance only; member names span political borders (Kohistan-Ladakh also covers Pakistan and India) and it is not a complete country index and does not promote reported coordinates to WGS84.

reported_spatial_grid: source-coordinate 1-degree floor cell; not cross-source comparable
spatial_grid: canonical EPSG:4326 1-degree floor cell; no interpolation
